The short melodic phrasing leads naturally into a definitive final chord accentuated by a percussive stamp around the 6-second mark, followed by a smooth, unhurried ringing decay that fades cleanly into silence.

**Audio Quality:**  
The production is pristine and well-balanced. There are no unintended clicks, digital artifacts, distortion, or abrupt cutoffs.
